sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: On the night of Tuesday, May 1, 1990, a group of family and friends gathered at a home on Misty Morning Drive in the town of Derry, New Hampshire.
sentences.zh: 1990年5月1日，星期二的晚上，一群亲友聚集在新罕布什尔州德里镇“迷雾晨路”的一处住宅内。

sentences.en: At around 10pm, as they broke out into a joyful rendition of Happy Birthday, their celebration was abruptly cut short by a blood-curdling scream.
sentences.zh: 晚上10点左右，当他们唱起欢快的生日歌时，一阵令人毛骨悚然的尖叫声突然打断了庆祝活动。

sentences.en: Fred Lombardi, the host of the party, rushed outside to see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 派对主人弗雷德·隆巴迪冲到屋外查看发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Disturbances were rare on the quiet cul-de-sac, which was largely made up of condominiums occupied by young couples.
sentences.zh: 在这个安静的死胡同里，骚乱很少发生，这里大多是年轻夫妇居住的公寓。

sentences.en: As Fred stepped into the street, he almost collided with his 22-year-old neighbour, Pamela Smart.
sentences.zh: 当弗雷德走到街上时，他差点撞上他22岁的邻居帕梅拉·斯马特。

sentences.en: Pamela had been running away from the unit she rented with her 24-year-old husband, Gregory.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉正从她与24岁的丈夫格雷戈里租住的公寓里跑出来。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: What's the matter?
sentences.zh: 出什么事了？

sentences.en: What's happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Fred asked.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德问道。

sentences.en: Pamela frantically replied,
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉惊慌失措地回答：

sentences.en: It's my husband.
sentences.zh: 是我丈夫。

sentences.en: He's been killed.
sentences.zh: 他被杀了。

sentences.en: He's dead.
sentences.zh: 他死了。

sentences.en: As Fred began moving toward the Smart residence, Pamela grabbed him and yelled,
sentences.zh: 当弗雷德开始向斯马特家走去时，帕梅拉一把抓住他并大喊：

sentences.en: No, don't go in there.
sentences.zh: 不，别进去。

sentences.en: It wouldn't do any good.
sentences.zh: 进去也没用。

sentences.en: He's dead.
sentences.zh: 他死了。

sentences.en: I know it.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Fred persisted, saying he wanted to help, but Pamela begged him not to.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德坚持说他想帮忙，但帕梅拉恳求他不要进去。

sentences.en: Please, she said.
sentences.zh: 求你了，她说。

sentences.en: Don't go in there.
sentences.zh: 别进去。

sentences.en: Just call the police.
sentences.zh: 快报警吧。

sentences.en: The first officer to arrive on scene observed Pamela Smart kneeling on the stoop of a neighbouring home, sobbing.
sentences.zh: 第一位赶到现场的警官看到帕梅拉·斯马特正跪在邻居家门口啜泣。

sentences.en: Onlookers directed him to the Smart's unit.
sentences.zh: 围观者指引他去了斯马特家的公寓。

sentences.en: Inside, the foyer light illuminated Gregory Smart, dressed in grey pants and a matching sports coat.
sentences.zh: 屋内，门厅的灯光照亮了格雷戈里·斯马特，他穿着灰色裤子和配套的运动外套。

sentences.en: He was lying face down, with his feet on the tiled foyer floor and the rest of his body on the carpet in the adjoining dining area.
sentences.zh: 他脸朝下躺着，双脚在铺着瓷砖的门厅地板上，身体其余部分则在相邻餐厅的地毯上。

sentences.en: A small amount of blood had pooled beneath his nose.
sentences.zh: 他的鼻子下方积了一小滩血。

sentences.en: As the officer went to roll Gregory over to begin CPR, he noticed a large fatal wound on the upper left side of his head.
sentences.zh: 当警官走过去翻转格雷戈里准备进行心肺复苏时，他注意到他头部左上方有一处巨大的致命伤。

sentences.en: No one else was found inside the residence, which had been ransacked.
sentences.zh: 屋内没有发现其他人，家里被翻得乱七八糟。

sentences.en: CDs were scattered everywhere, a VCR was overturned on the floor, and stereo speakers were placed by the back door along with the small television.
sentences.zh: CD散落得到处都是，录像机被掀翻在地，立体声扬声器和小电视被堆放在后门边。

sentences.en: It appeared that a burglar had been piling their loot there in preparation to flee when they were interrupted by Gregory arriving home.
sentences.zh: 看起来窃贼正把赃物堆在那里准备逃跑，却被回家的格雷戈里撞见了。

sentences.en: He was shot once in the head at close range, killing him instantly.
sentences.zh: 他头部近距离中了一枪，当场死亡。

sentences.en: The main bedroom upstairs was also in disarray.
sentences.zh: 楼上的主卧也一片狼藉。

sentences.en: Drawers had been pulled out, clothing was tossed about, and an empty jewellery box was found in the bathroom sink.
sentences.zh: 抽屉被拉开，衣服被扔得到处都是，洗手池里发现了一个空的珠宝盒。

sentences.en: Given the upstairs area was less messy than downstairs, investigators surmised that at least two people were involved in the crime, one less haphazard than the other.
sentences.zh: 鉴于楼上的混乱程度比楼下轻，调查人员推测这起犯罪至少有两人参与，其中一人没那么毛躁。

sentences.en: Pillow stuffing was found throughout the unit, and several sofa pillows were missing, suggesting they had been emptied and used as bags to carry stolen goods.
sentences.zh: 屋内到处都是枕头里的填充物，几个沙发靠垫不见了，这表明它们被掏空后当作了装赃物的袋子。

sentences.en: The Smart's small pet dog, which usually roamed freely throughout the residence, was found locked in the cellar.
sentences.zh: 斯马特家平时在屋里自由活动的小宠物狗被发现关在地窖里。

sentences.en: Behind the condominium was a grassy hill leading to parkland, commonly used as a shortcut to a nearby shopping plaza.
sentences.zh: 公寓后面是一座通往公园的草坡，通常被用作前往附近购物广场的捷径。

sentences.en: About 100 yards from the Smart's condo, in a mowed area, police found a carving knife embedded in the ground,
sentences.zh: 在距离斯马特公寓约100码的一片修剪过的草地上，警方发现了一把插在地里的雕刻刀，

sentences.en: along with paper towels, a plastic jewellery box, and parts of a cardboard jewellery box, all of which had come from the Smart residence.
sentences.zh: 旁边还有纸巾、一个塑料珠宝盒和一些纸板珠宝盒的碎片，这些东西都来自斯马特家。

sentences.en: During an interview with police that night, Pamela Smart stated she worked as a media coordinator for School Administrative Unit 21,
sentences.zh: 当晚在接受警方采访时，帕梅拉·斯马特称她在第21学区行政单位担任媒体协调员，

sentences.en: which oversaw several school districts across the state.
sentences.zh: 该单位负责监管全州多个学区。

sentences.en: Her office building was across from Winnicunit High School, just under an hour's drive from her home.
sentences.zh: 她的办公室大楼就在温尼库尼特高中的对面，距离她家不到一小时车程。

sentences.en: Gregory worked as a salesman for his father's insurance firm and left home that day at 9am.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里在她父亲的保险公司担任销售员，当天早上9点离家。

sentences.en: Pamela left at about 9.45, slightly later than usual because she was attending a school board meeting that evening.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉大约9点45分离开，比平时晚了一点，因为她当晚要参加一个学校董事会会议。

sentences.en: When she returned home at around 10.10pm, Gregory's pickup truck was parked outside, but the internal house lights were off and the front door was locked.
sentences.zh: 当她晚上10点10分左右回到家时，格雷戈里的皮卡车停在外面，但屋内的灯是关着的，前门也锁着。

sentences.en: Upon entering the unit, Pamela turned on the foyer light and discovered Gregory's lifeless body.
sentences.zh: 进入公寓后，帕梅拉打开门厅的灯，发现了格雷戈里毫无生气的尸体。

sentences.en: There was no sign of forced entry around to the unit, but Pamela suggested the rear French doors might have been left unlocked after a recent gathering.
sentences.zh: 公寓周围没有强行闯入的迹象，但帕梅拉表示，后门的法式门可能因为最近的一次聚会而没锁好。

sentences.en: Investigators also found the bulkhead leading to the cellar unsecured.
sentences.zh: 调查人员还发现通往地窖的舱门没有锁好。

sentences.en: Given that the Smarts didn't usually leave lights on when they were away,
sentences.zh: 鉴于斯马特夫妇平时不在家时不会开灯，

sentences.en: Gregory likely entered the dark unit without sensing any danger.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里很可能是在毫无防备的情况下进入了黑暗的屋子。

sentences.en: Pamela was cooperative with investigators and willing to assist them in any way.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉配合调查人员，并愿意以任何方式提供协助。

sentences.en: However, they noted that she was unusually composed for someone who had just found her husband brutally murdered.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们注意到，对于一个刚发现丈夫惨遭谋杀的人来说，她表现得异常冷静。

sentences.en: She didn't cry during questioning and appeared more anxious than distressed.
sentences.zh: 她在审讯过程中没有哭，看起来更多的是焦虑而不是悲痛。

sentences.en: Her eyes frequently moved around the room and she seemed tense.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛频繁地在房间里转动，显得很紧张。

sentences.en: Investigators spoke with Pamela again the following day.
sentences.zh: 调查人员第二天再次与帕梅拉谈话。

sentences.en: She was just as calm and collected as the night before.
sentences.zh: 她依然像前一天晚上一样冷静沉着。

sentences.en: They assured her that they meant no offence, but they needed to know if she and Gregory were experiencing any problems,
sentences.zh: 他们向她保证无意冒犯，但他们需要知道她和格雷戈里之间是否存在问题，

sentences.en: such as financial difficulties, drug or alcohol issues, or infidelity.
sentences.zh: 比如经济困难、毒品或酒精问题，或者不忠行为。

sentences.en: Pamela said no.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉说没有。

sentences.en: She and Gregory had only been married for a year and both had been doing well.
sentences.zh: 她和格雷戈里结婚才一年，两人一直过得很好。

sentences.en: She had just received a $26,000 pay rise and was enjoying her work, viewing it as a stepping stone toward a career in broadcasting.
sentences.zh: 她刚获得了2.6万美元的加薪，并且很享受她的工作，将其视为迈向广播事业的垫脚石。

sentences.en: Gregory had recently co-won a Rookie Salesman of the Year award.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里最近还共同获得了“年度最佳新人销售员”奖。

sentences.en: Outgoing and sociable, he had no known enemies and was widely described as the kind of person who would give someone the shirt off his back.
sentences.zh: 他性格开朗、善于交际，没有已知的敌人，被广泛描述为那种愿意为别人两肋插刀的人。

sentences.en: The pair had met in 1986 at a New Year's Eve party Gregory was hosting.
sentences.zh: 两人于1986年在格雷戈里举办的一场新年前夜派对上相识。

sentences.en: He was a long-haired, good-looking metalhead, contrasting with Pamela's image as a petite, popular cheerleader.
sentences.zh: 他是一个留着长发、长相帅气的金属乐迷，与帕梅拉娇小、受欢迎的啦啦队长形象形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: But she had a hidden edge.
sentences.zh: 但她隐藏着锋芒。

sentences.en: She enjoyed the same type of music as Gregory and the two quickly hit it off and went on several dates.
sentences.zh: 她和格雷戈里喜欢同类型的音乐，两人很快一拍即合，并约会了几次。

sentences.en: Pamela quickly developed strong feelings for Gregory, but at the time he wasn't ready to commit to a serious relationship.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉很快对格雷戈里产生了强烈的感情，但当时他还没准备好投入一段认真的关系。

sentences.en: The two remained in contact after Pamela left for college and months later, she visited Gregory and discovered he was casually seeing someone else.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉去上大学后，两人仍保持联系。几个月后，她去看望格雷戈里，发现他正在和别人随意交往。

sentences.en: Pamela forced him to choose between her and the other woman.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉强迫他在她和那个女人之间做出选择。

sentences.en: To her surprise and disappointment, Gregory ended their relationship on the spot, still unwilling to commit.
sentences.zh: 令她惊讶和失望的是，格雷戈里当场结束了他们的关系，依然不愿做出承诺。

sentences.en: That summer, they crossed paths again during a vacation with mutual friends.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天，他们在与共同朋友度假时再次相遇。

sentences.en: Their romance rekindled and Gregory began having serious feelings about Pamela.
sentences.zh: 他们的恋情重燃，格雷戈里开始对帕梅拉产生了认真的感情。

sentences.en: She was thrilled when he finally agreed to move in together and get engaged.
sentences.zh: 当他最终同意同居并订婚时，她欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: The wedding was an extravagant event attended by more than 200 guests.
sentences.zh: 婚礼是一场盛大的活动，有200多名宾客参加。

sentences.en: By all accounts, it went perfectly.
sentences.zh: 据各方说法，婚礼进行得非常完美。

sentences.en: Yet, those who knew Gregory well were surprised at his decision to marry at a young age.
sentences.zh: 然而，那些了解格雷戈里的人对他年纪轻轻就决定结婚感到惊讶。

sentences.en: He had typically been the life of the party and not someone who appeared eager to settle down.
sentences.zh: 他通常是派对的灵魂人物，看起来并不急于安定下来。

sentences.en: By that point, Gregory had cut off his long hair, replaced his band t-shirts with a suit and tie, and was preparing to enter the corporate world.
sentences.zh: 到那时，格雷戈里已经剪掉了长发，把乐队T恤换成了西装领带，准备进入企业界。

sentences.en: Even so, the newly wedded couple appeared happy when they left for their honeymoon.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，这对新婚夫妇在去度蜜月时看起来还是很幸福。

sentences.en: But once they returned, the critical side of Pamela's personality started to cause friction in the marriage.
sentences.zh: 但他们回来后，帕梅拉性格中挑剔的一面开始导致婚姻出现摩擦。

sentences.en: As a wedding present, her family had given the couple substantial amounts of cash and expensive iteMs.
sentences.zh: 作为结婚礼物，她的家人给了这对夫妇一大笔现金和昂贵的物品。

sentences.en: Pamela was annoyed that Gregory's family had contributed comparatively little, in some cases barely enough to cover the cost of their meal.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉很恼火，因为格雷戈里的家人贡献得相对较少，有些情况下甚至勉强够付他们的餐费。

sentences.en: Unlike Pamela, who had a more distant relationship with her family,
sentences.zh: 与帕梅拉不同，她与家人的关系比较疏远，

sentences.en: Gregory was very close to his own.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里与自己的家人非常亲近。

sentences.en: He grew irritated by her complaints and eventually told her he'd heard enough.
sentences.zh: 他对她的抱怨感到厌烦，最终告诉她他听够了。

sentences.en: But she wouldn't let the matter go.
sentences.zh: 但她不肯罢休。

sentences.en: Pamela was known to make sharp or cutting remarks that left others feeling hurt in order to elevate herself by comparison.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉以言辞尖刻伤人而闻名，她通过贬低他人来抬高自己。

sentences.en: Some believed this behaviour stemmed from deep-seated insecurities, despite Pamela being widely regarded as physically attractive, popular and successful.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为这种行为源于根深蒂固的不安全感，尽管帕梅拉被广泛认为外表迷人、受欢迎且事业有成。

sentences.en: These traits also made her competitive and possessive, with others describing her as someone who harboured a simmering anger beneath the surface.
sentences.zh: 这些特质也使她好胜且占有欲强，其他人形容她是一个表面下潜藏着愤怒的人。

sentences.en: Gregory took amusement in provoking his wife with passive-aggressive acts, including deliberately mispronouncing her name and making suggestive comments about other women.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里以激怒妻子为乐，采取被动攻击的行为，包括故意念错她的名字，以及对其他女性发表暗示性评论。

sentences.en: Whenever Pamela tried to confront Gregory or draw him into an argument, he dismissed her frustrations with a simple whatever, which only infuriated her further.
sentences.zh: 每当帕梅拉试图与格雷戈里对质或把他拉入争吵时，他总是用一句简单的“随便”来打发她的挫败感，这只会让她更加愤怒。

sentences.en: The couple's strong, ego-driven personalities often clashed, as did their differences.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇强烈的自我驱动型人格经常发生冲突，他们的差异也是如此。

sentences.en: Pamela was ambitious, determined and highly organised, always planning for the future.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉雄心勃勃、意志坚定且组织能力极强，总是为未来做规划。

sentences.en: Gregory was laid back, carefree and content to spend his time kicking back with friends.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里则随遇而安、无忧无虑，满足于和朋友们消磨时光。

sentences.en: Pamela also grew unhappy that Gregory, who had flexible work hours, was often away from home in the evenings.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉还对格雷戈里工作时间灵活、晚上经常不在家感到不满。

sentences.en: Gregory told a friend that Pamela wanted him to quit his job, but he refused, as he enjoyed his work and the income it provided.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里告诉一位朋友，帕梅拉想让他辞职，但他拒绝了，因为他喜欢这份工作及其带来的收入。

sentences.en: Given that much of his free time was spent with friends pursuing hobbies such as playing cards, golfing and off-roading, activities Pamela had little interest in,
sentences.zh: 鉴于他大部分空闲时间都和朋友们一起从事打牌、打高尔夫和越野等帕梅拉不感兴趣的爱好，

sentences.en: the couple spent relatively little of their leisure time together.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇在一起的休闲时间相对较少。

sentences.en: Pamela focused on her own interests, including taking courses related to media and public relations, and reading upwards of six newspapers a day.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉专注于自己的兴趣，包括参加与媒体和公共关系相关的课程，每天阅读六份以上的报纸。

sentences.en: She had dreams of becoming a nationally recognised reporter, just like the anchorwomen and journalists she admired.
sentences.zh: 她梦想成为一名全国知名的记者，就像她崇拜的那些女主播和记者一样。

sentences.en: Many people in the smart social circle were completely unaware of any serious issues in the marriage.
sentences.zh: 斯马特社交圈里的许多人完全不知道他们的婚姻存在任何严重问题。

sentences.en: For the most part, the couple presented themselves as coping fine and capable of recovering from their disagreements.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，这对夫妇表现得相处融洽，有能力从分歧中恢复过来。

sentences.en: They would regularly go out for dinner or drinks with friends, host gatherings at their home, and were planning a vacation together.
sentences.zh: 他们经常和朋友一起出去吃饭或喝酒，在家里举办聚会，还计划一起去度假。

sentences.en: Gregory had even mentioned that he was preparing a celebration for their one-year wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里甚至提到他正在筹备他们的结婚一周年纪念日庆祝活动。

sentences.en: Yet, there were some who still believed the marriage was doomed to fail.
sentences.zh: 然而，仍有一些人认为这段婚姻注定会失败。

sentences.en: Both Gregory and Pamela had confided in others about fundamental issues and differing expectations for the future.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里和帕梅拉都曾向他人吐露过婚姻的基本问题以及对未来不同的期望。

sentences.en: Gregory wanted to buy a house and have children, but Pamela wasn't interested.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里想买房生子，但帕梅拉没兴趣。

sentences.en: While venting with a friend about the problems they had with their respective partners,
sentences.zh: 当与朋友发泄各自伴侣的问题时，

sentences.en: Pamela asked,
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉问道：

sentences.en: Why can't they just die and make our life easier?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么不能直接死掉，让我们的生活更轻松些？

sentences.en: No divorce, no nothing.
sentences.zh: 不用离婚，什么都不用。

sentences.en: Just disappear.
sentences.zh: 直接消失就好。

sentences.en: Gregory's murder occurred just days shy of his and Pamela's one-year wedding anniversary.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里的谋杀案发生在他和帕梅拉结婚一周年纪念日前几天。

sentences.en: The only moment Pamela's stoic demeanour shifted during her early conversations with police was when they advised her not to speak to the press.
sentences.zh: 在与警方的早期谈话中，帕梅拉唯一一次表现出冷静态度的转变，是当他们建议她不要接受媒体采访时。

sentences.en: She became noticeably defensive, saying,
sentences.zh: 她明显变得具有防御性，说道：

sentences.en: Don't talk bad about them.
sentences.zh: 别说他们的坏话。

sentences.en: I'm one of them too.
sentences.zh: 我也是他们中的一员。

sentences.en: Investigators found it odd that she seemed more upset by their comments about the media than by her own husband's brutal and untimely death.
sentences.zh: 调查人员觉得很奇怪，她似乎对他们关于媒体的评论比对她丈夫惨遭谋杀感到更不安。

sentences.en: Pamela's behaviour raised further suspicion once police had finished processing the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 警方处理完犯罪现场后，帕梅拉的行为引起了进一步的怀疑。

sentences.en: As they prepared to leave the unit, she was allowed inside to collect clothing for Gregory's funeral.
sentences.zh: 当他们准备离开公寓时，她被允许进入屋内为格雷戈里的葬礼收集衣物。

sentences.en: A towel had been placed over the bloodstain in the dining room to spare her from seeing it, and she stepped across it nonchalantly.
sentences.zh: 为了不让她看到餐厅里的血迹，上面盖了一条毛巾，她漫不经心地跨了过去。

sentences.en: She also reprimanded an officer for closing the rear doors against the drapes and complained about fingerprint powder on the sofa, demanding to know who would clean it up.
sentences.zh: 她还斥责了一名将后门关上压住窗帘的警官，并抱怨沙发上的指纹粉，要求知道谁来清理。

sentences.en: When she went upstairs to select the clothes Gregory would be buried in, she moved quickly and without hesitation, opening drawers and grabbing whatever was there.
sentences.zh: 当她上楼挑选格雷戈里的入殓服时，她动作迅速且毫不犹豫，打开抽屉，抓起什么就是什么。

sentences.en: She took no time to pause, mourn or reflect.
sentences.zh: 她没有停下来哀悼或反思。

sentences.en: Nothing she selected even matched.
sentences.zh: 她选的东西甚至都不搭配。

sentences.en: It was only after she stepped outside that she finally broke down in the presence of Gregory's parents.
sentences.zh: 直到她走出屋外，在格雷戈里的父母面前，她才终于崩溃。

sentences.en: Investigators spoke to the smart's neighbours and only one recalled hearing anything unusual on the night that Gregory was killed.
sentences.zh: 调查人员询问了斯马特家的邻居，只有一个人记得在格雷戈里被杀的那晚听到过异常情况。

sentences.en: He had heard Gregory arrive home at around 9pm,
sentences.zh: 他听到格雷戈里在晚上9点左右到家，

sentences.en: followed by the pitter-patter of feet across the floor and then two loud thuds which came several minutes apart and sounded like doors slamming.
sentences.zh: 随后是地板上急促的脚步声，接着是两声沉重的撞击声，间隔几分钟，听起来像门关上的声音。

sentences.en: The decision to target the smart's unit was strange.
sentences.zh: 选择斯马特家作为目标很奇怪。

sentences.en: Breaking into a densely populated condominium complex at night when most residents were likely to be home was reckless.
sentences.zh: 在晚上大多数居民可能都在家的时候闯入人口稠密的公寓大楼是鲁莽的。

sentences.en: Such risky behaviour was more commonly associated with amateur opportunistic offenders who were typically unarmed.
sentences.zh: 这种冒险行为通常与业余的投机型罪犯有关，他们通常没有武器。

sentences.en: Those who did bring guns rarely used them, let alone to deliberately execute an innocent person in cold blood.
sentences.zh: 那些带枪的人也很少使用，更不用说冷血地蓄意处决一个无辜的人了。

sentences.en: They were also the type to steal small, easily pocketed items that they could immediately use, sell or discard, such as wallets, keys and jewellery,
sentences.zh: 他们也属于那种会偷窃钱包、钥匙和珠宝等可以立即使用、出售或丢弃的小型、易于携带的物品的人，

sentences.en: rather than large, bulky electronics.
sentences.zh: 而不是大型、笨重的电子产品。

sentences.en: But Gregory's diamond and gold wedding ring was found underneath his body and his wallet and car keys were left between his legs.
sentences.zh: 但格雷戈里的钻石金婚戒被发现压在他的尸体下，他的钱包和车钥匙被留在双腿之间。

sentences.en: There was no cash in the wallet, but all of his credit cards were inside.
sentences.zh: 钱包里没有现金，但所有的信用卡都在里面。

sentences.en: If more experienced defenders were responsible for Gregory's murder, investigators questioned why they abandoned the job
sentences.zh: 如果格雷戈里的谋杀案是更有经验的罪犯所为，调查人员质疑他们为什么要放弃作案，

sentences.en: and left behind much of the property they had gathered to steal.
sentences.zh: 并留下他们收集的大部分赃物。

sentences.en: As for suspects, there were few obvious leads.
sentences.zh: 至于嫌疑人，明显的线索很少。

sentences.en: Gregory enjoyed taking trips to Atlantic City with friends and family where he gambled.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里喜欢和亲友去大西洋城旅行，并在那里赌博。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered whether he could have accumulated debts with the wrong people.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑他是否欠了不该欠的人的债。

sentences.en: Neighbours also reported an increase in parties and get-togethers at the smart unit in recent weeks, with a variety of people coming and going from the residence.
sentences.zh: 邻居们也反映，最近几周那间时髦的公寓里聚会和派对增多了，各种各样的人进进出出。

sentences.en: Some were noted as looking suspicious.
sentences.zh: 有人注意到其中一些人看起来很可疑。

sentences.en: This prompted speculation that drugs might be involved.
sentences.zh: 这引发了人们对可能涉及毒品的猜测。

sentences.en: The theory gained some traction when a cannabis cigarette was found in Gregory's pickup truck.
sentences.zh: 当在格雷戈里的皮卡车里发现一支大麻烟卷时，这一理论得到了一些支持。

sentences.en: However, no other illicit substances were discovered in his vehicle, unit or anywhere else on the property,
sentences.zh: 然而，在他的车里、公寓里或房产的其他任何地方都没有发现其他违禁品，

sentences.en: and he had no prior history of major drug use or interactions with the police.
sentences.zh: 而且他此前也没有重大吸毒史或与警方打交道的记录。

sentences.en: Whatever the explanation, investigators increasingly suspected they were dealing with something more than a burglary gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 无论解释是什么，调查人员越来越怀疑他们处理的不仅仅是一起入室盗窃失败的案件。

sentences.en: Against investigators' advice, Pamela Smart spoke to the press about her husband's case.
sentences.zh: 不顾调查人员的劝阻，帕梅拉·斯马特向媒体谈论了她丈夫的案件。

sentences.en: She said she wanted to dispel the growing rumours that the killing was drug-related, insisting that she simply wanted the truth to be known.
sentences.zh: 她说她想消除关于这起谋杀案与毒品有关的日益增长的谣言，并坚称她只是想让真相大白。

sentences.en: While details of the crime were being kept under wraps to protect the integrity of the investigation,
sentences.zh: 虽然为了保护调查的完整性，犯罪细节一直处于保密状态，

sentences.en: Pamela openly disclosed some of the confidential information during a filmed media interview.
sentences.zh: 但帕梅拉在一次媒体采访中公开披露了一些机密信息。

sentences.en: She described the crime scene in considerable detail, revealing that the unit had been ransacked, that stereo speakers had been left by the back door,
sentences.zh: 她相当详细地描述了犯罪现场，透露公寓被洗劫一空，立体声扬声器被留在后门旁，

sentences.en: and that $300 worth of jewellery was missing.
sentences.zh: 还有价值300美元的珠宝不见了。

sentences.en: She also referred to the theory that the killing was a botched burglary, and stated that there were no witnesses.
sentences.zh: 她还提到了关于这起谋杀案是一起拙劣的入室盗窃案的说法，并声称没有目击者。

sentences.en: The interview took place on the day of Gregory's wake.
sentences.zh: 这次采访是在格雷戈里的守灵仪式当天进行的。

sentences.en: At the event, Pamela received an outpouring of support from those in attendance.
sentences.zh: 在仪式上，帕梅拉得到了出席者的大力支持。

sentences.en: She also announced that she had established a memorial fund in Gregory's name to purchase equipment for a mass media course at Winnicunit High School.
sentences.zh: 她还宣布，她以格雷戈里的名义设立了一个纪念基金，为温尼库尼特高中的大众传媒课程购买设备。

sentences.en: The class was a recent addition to the school, having been approved during the board meeting held on the night Gregory was murdered, the same meeting Pamela had attended.
sentences.zh: 这门课是学校最近新增的，在格雷戈里遇害当晚举行的董事会会议上获得批准，而帕梅拉也参加了那次会议。

sentences.en: Notably, she had been selected to teach the course.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，她被选中教授这门课程。

sentences.en: Pamela explained that she wanted something positive to come from the tragedy, and for Gregory to remain a part of her daily life.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉解释说，她希望这场悲剧能带来一些积极的结果，并希望格雷戈里能继续成为她日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: During the wake, three students from Winnicunit High School arrived with a guidance counsellor.
sentences.zh: 守灵期间，温尼库尼特高中的三名学生在一名辅导员的陪同下赶到。

sentences.en: Having heard about Gregory's tragic death, the counsellor believed it would be appropriate for the students to pay their respects, as they were all well acquainted with Pamela.
sentences.zh: 在得知格雷戈里不幸去世的消息后，辅导员认为学生们去表达敬意是合适的，因为他们都和帕梅拉很熟。

sentences.en: The students were 15-year-old Cecilia Pierce,
sentences.zh: 这三名学生分别是15岁的塞西莉亚·皮尔斯，

sentences.en: 16-year-old Billy Flynn, and 17-year-old Vance Latamy Jr.
sentences.zh: 16岁的比利·弗林和17岁的万斯·拉塔米二世。

sentences.en: Cecilia was a student intern in the media centre who worked directly with Pamela, while Billy had recently received assistance from Pamela for a videotaped competition at school.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚是媒体中心的实习生，直接与帕梅拉共事，而比利最近在学校的一次录像比赛中得到了帕梅拉的帮助。

sentences.en: Vance was less familiar with Pamela than the other two, but still closer to her than moSt.
sentences.zh: 万斯虽然不像另外两人那样熟悉帕梅拉，但也比大多数人更亲近她。

sentences.en: Pamela appeared surprised to see the three teenagers, whose presence at the wake drew some attention, but she thanked them for attending.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉对这三名青少年的出现感到惊讶，他们的到来引起了一些关注，但她还是感谢了他们的出席。

sentences.en: She introduced them to several people and spent a short time speaking with them.
sentences.zh: 她把他们介绍给了一些人，并和他们交谈了一会儿。

sentences.en: At one point, Billy and Vance approached Gregory's casket and knelt beside it.
sentences.zh: 有一次，比利和万斯走到格雷戈里的棺材旁，跪在旁边。

sentences.en: The group remained at the wake for less than 15 minutes before leaving.
sentences.zh: 这群人在离开前在守灵仪式上停留了不到15分钟。

sentences.en: More than 200 people attended Gregory's funeral.
sentences.zh: 200多人参加了格雷戈里的葬礼。

sentences.en: Among them were investigators keeping watch for anyone who might appear suspicious, but once again, it was Pamela who drew their attention.
sentences.zh: 其中包括正在留意任何可疑人员的调查人员，但再次引起他们注意的还是帕梅拉。

sentences.en: During the service, she asked Gregory's father whether he had requested a full or half-mass.
sentences.zh: 在仪式期间，她问格雷戈里的父亲是否要求举行全弥撒或半弥撒。

sentences.en: He didn't understand what she meant, prompting Pamela to explain that she had instructed the priest to make it short.
sentences.zh: 他没听懂她的意思，帕梅拉便解释说她已经指示牧师缩短仪式时间。

sentences.en: As she left the church, where members of the media had gathered outside,
sentences.zh: 当她离开教堂时，媒体成员聚集在外面，

sentences.en: Pamela appeared more openly grief-stricken.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉看起来更加公开地表现出悲痛。

sentences.en: Before being driven away, she rolled down her car window and tearfully told reporters,
sentences.zh: 在被开车送走之前，她摇下车窗，含泪对记者说：

sentences.en: I'd just like to say Gregory was the kindest person I ever knew.
sentences.zh: “我只想说，格雷戈里是我认识的最善良的人。”

sentences.en: He was a really good friend of mine, and he didn't deserve this.
sentences.zh: “他是我非常好的朋友，他不该遭遇这种事。”

sentences.en: At the burial, Pamela placed a single rose on Gregory's coffin.
sentences.zh: 在下葬时，帕梅拉在格雷戈里的棺材上放了一朵玫瑰花。

sentences.en: Inside, a framed photograph of the young couple on their wedding day rested in his hands.
sentences.zh: 棺材里，这对年轻夫妇婚礼当天的装裱照片放在他的手中。

sentences.en: Pamela continued to assist the police investigation by providing any requested information, including names of individuals Gregory was associated with.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉继续通过提供任何被要求的信息来协助警方调查，包括格雷戈里交往对象的名单。

sentences.en: She was overly eager to help, often oversupplying irrelevant details that police hadn't asked for, which only served to muddy their work.
sentences.zh: 她表现得过于热心，经常提供警方并未询问的无关细节，这只会让他们的工作变得混乱。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Pamela's continued willingness to speak to the press and disclose sensitive information was an ongoing issue.
sentences.zh: 此外，帕梅拉不断愿意向媒体发表讲话并披露敏感信息，这是一个持续存在的问题。

sentences.en: One investigator even contacted Pamela's father and asked him to speak with her about her behaviour.
sentences.zh: 一名调查人员甚至联系了帕梅拉的父亲，请他谈谈她的行为。

sentences.en: Eventually, they decided to stop updating Pamela on the case altogether.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们决定完全停止向帕梅拉通报案件进展。

sentences.en: Reporters frequently contacted Pamela for comment, and she never declined the opportunity to be interviewed.
sentences.zh: 记者经常联系帕梅拉寻求评论，她从不拒绝接受采访的机会。

sentences.en: Each time, she emphasised that Gregory's death was the result of him interrupting a burglary.
sentences.zh: 每次，她都强调格雷戈里的死是因为他打断了一起入室盗窃。

sentences.en: She also maintained that Gregory didn't have any enemies, and described his killer as a, quote, drug addict person looking for a quick ten dollars.
sentences.zh: 她还坚持认为格雷戈里没有任何敌人，并将凶手描述为“一个为了区区十美元而寻找目标的瘾君子”。

sentences.en: If she knew who it was, Pamela said it would have been the first name she gave to the police.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉说，如果她知道是谁干的，那将是她提供给警方的第一个名字。

sentences.en: While some thought Pamela's unusual behaviour was simply an irrational response to grief, others suspected she couldn't resist the attention,
sentences.zh: 虽然有些人认为帕梅拉不同寻常的行为仅仅是对悲伤的非理性反应，但另一些人则怀疑她无法抗拒关注，

sentences.en: having always been drawn to the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 因为她一直被聚光灯所吸引。

sentences.en: Reporters noted that Pamela showed little visible emotion when speaking about her husband or his murder.
sentences.zh: 记者们注意到，帕梅拉在谈论她的丈夫或他的谋杀案时，几乎没有表现出明显的情绪。

sentences.en: Her interactions with them also felt controlled, with observers suggesting she was drawing on her media training to manage her public image.
sentences.zh: 她与他们的互动也感觉受到控制，观察人士认为她正在利用她的媒体培训来管理自己的公众形象。

sentences.en: On what would have been the Smart's one-year wedding anniversary, an article about the case was published in the Telegraph under the headline,
sentences.zh: 在斯马特夫妇本应结婚一周年纪念日那天，《电讯报》发表了一篇关于此案的文章，标题是：

sentences.en: But Pamela Smart, Life Must Go On.
sentences.zh: “但帕梅拉·斯马特，生活必须继续。”

sentences.en: In it, Pamela maintained that she and Gregory had been happy, with no problems, and that they simply wanted to be together.
sentences.zh: 文中，帕梅拉坚称她和格雷戈里一直很幸福，没有任何问题，他们只是想在一起。

sentences.en: She said Gregory was the kind of person who would reassure her that things would always work out,
sentences.zh: 她说格雷戈里是那种会安慰她一切都会好起来的人，

sentences.en: and that she was now drawing on that sentiment as a way to cope and move on with her life.
sentences.zh: 而她现在正利用这种情感作为应对和继续生活的方式。

sentences.en: Pamela delivered Gregory's personal belongings to his parents' home without ceremony.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉将格雷戈里的个人物品送到了他父母家，没有举行任何仪式。

sentences.en: Among the items was a piece of wedding cake the couple had stored in their freezer for a later occasion, which she handed over, saying,
sentences.zh: 其中有一块这对夫妇存放在冰箱里留作以后食用的结婚蛋糕，她把它交出来说：

sentences.en: Here, you take this.
sentences.zh: “给你，这个你拿去吧。”

sentences.en: I don't like cake anyway.
sentences.zh: “反正我不喜欢吃蛋糕。”

sentences.en: She then invited friends over to her unit and began giving away the rest of Gregory's things.
sentences.zh: 然后她邀请朋友到她的公寓，开始分发格雷戈里剩下的东西。

sentences.en: She served lunch and spoke joyfully within steps of the bloodstain in the dining room, which still hadn't been cleaned.
sentences.zh: 她招待大家吃午饭，并在餐厅里距离血迹仅几步之遥的地方欢快地交谈，而那血迹还没被清理干净。

sentences.en: Pamela then began looking for a new car, intending to use part of Gregory's $140,000 life insurance payout to purchase it.
sentences.zh: 随后，帕梅拉开始物色新车，打算用格雷戈里14万美元人寿保险赔偿金的一部分来购买。

sentences.en: Within weeks of the murder, she went out drinking with friends, who were surprised by how happy she seemed.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生几周后，她和朋友们出去喝酒，朋友们对她看起来如此快乐感到惊讶。

sentences.en: One night, while watching a band she liked,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，在看她喜欢的乐队演出时，

sentences.en: Pamela got up on stage to sing with an ex-boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉走上舞台与一位前男友一起唱歌。

sentences.en: Afterwards, she gave him her number and urged him to visit.
sentences.zh: 事后，她给了他自己的号码，并催促他去拜访。

sentences.en: She was also witness to dancing up against other men and, in a flippant, matter-of-fact manner, told other revellers that her husband had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 她还被目击与其他男人贴身跳舞，并以一种轻率、公事公办的态度告诉其他狂欢者，她的丈夫被谋杀了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, investigators distributed flyers featuring images of the jewellery stolen from the smarts to pawn shops.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员向当铺分发了印有斯马特夫妇被盗珠宝图片的传单。

sentences.en: They pursued a range of leads, including a criminal group posing as police officers to gain entry to homes and a former jilted lover of Gregory's.
sentences.zh: 他们追踪了一系列线索，包括一个冒充警察进入住宅的犯罪团伙，以及格雷戈里的一位被抛弃的前情人。

sentences.en: But none of these leads went anywhere.
sentences.zh: 但这些线索都没有任何进展。

sentences.en: A significant development finally emerged on Monday, May 14, two weeks after Gregory Smart's murder.
sentences.zh: 5月14日星期一，即格雷戈里·斯马特遇害两周后，终于出现了一个重大进展。

sentences.en: That night, the Derry Police Department received an anonymous phone call.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，德里警察局接到了一个匿名电话。

sentences.en: Deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: The caller was a nervous-sounding woman.
sentences.zh: 打电话的是一个声音紧张的女人。

sentences.en: While she said she didn't want to get involved, she felt compelled to pass on information she had heard, even if it was just hearsay.
sentences.zh: 虽然她说她不想卷入其中，但她觉得有必要传递她听到的信息，即使那只是道听途说。

sentences.en: Speaking of Gregory Smart's murder, the woman stated,
sentences.zh: 在谈到格雷戈里·斯马特的谋杀案时，该女子说：

sentences.en: his wife planned him to be killed.
sentences.zh: “他的妻子策划了对他的谋杀。”

sentences.en: She claimed Pamela Smart had been putting on a wonderful performance since, with the motive being Gregory's life insurance money.
sentences.zh: 她声称帕梅拉·斯马特此后一直在演一场精彩的戏，动机是格雷戈里的人寿保险金。

sentences.en: The tipster admitted that she had obtained the information secondhand from a minor, eventually revealing it had come from a 15-year-old girl.
sentences.zh: 举报人承认，她是间接从一个未成年人那里获得的信息，最终透露消息来自一个15岁的女孩。

sentences.en: While she refused to name the girl at first, after some gentle probing from the detective, the woman said the girl was named Cecilia Pierce.
sentences.zh: 虽然她起初拒绝透露女孩的名字，但在侦探的温和盘问下，该女子说那个女孩叫塞西莉亚·皮尔斯。

sentences.en: She said Cecilia was friends with Pamela and she had attended Gregory's funeral.
sentences.zh: 她说塞西莉亚是帕梅拉的朋友，她参加了格雷戈里的葬礼。

sentences.en: She then hung up.
sentences.zh: 然后她挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Investigators discovered Cecilia Pierce was a student at Winnicunit High School.
sentences.zh: 调查人员发现塞西莉亚·皮尔斯是温尼库尼特高中的一名学生。

sentences.en: She had worked with Pamela Smart as a student intern in the media centre and had attended Gregory's wake.
sentences.zh: 她曾作为媒体中心的实习生与帕梅拉·斯马特共事，并参加了格雷戈里的守灵仪式。

sentences.en: Further enquiries showed that Cecilia had also visited Pamela at her condo the week before Gregory's murder, a meeting Pamela didn't initially disclose to the police.
sentences.zh: 进一步调查显示，在格雷戈里遇害前一周，塞西莉亚还去公寓拜访过帕梅拉，帕梅拉起初并未向警方披露这次会面。

sentences.en: Cecilia's name was also notably absent from the list of acquaintances that Pamela initially provided to investigators.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，帕梅拉最初提供给调查人员的熟人名单中也没有塞西莉亚的名字。

sentences.en: It appeared only later, about a week after the murder, in a separate list of friends of Pamela's that she didn't share with Gregory.
sentences.zh: 这个名字直到谋杀案发生约一周后，才出现在帕梅拉的一份没有与格雷戈里分享的独立朋友名单中。

sentences.en: Talkative and friendly,
sentences.zh: 健谈且友好，

sentences.en: Cecilia Pierce first introduced herself to Pamela Smart at school.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚·皮尔斯在学校第一次向帕梅拉·斯马特做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: Cecilia wanted to be a reporter, but was somewhat of an outcast among her peers for being overweight, living in a rough area and having a difficult home life.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚想成为一名记者，但因超重、住在贫困地区以及家庭生活困难，她在同龄人中有点像个局外人。

sentences.en: Her parents were divorced and her mother struggled to support Cecilia and her younger sister.
sentences.zh: 她的父母离异，母亲努力供养她和她年幼的妹妹。

sentences.en: Cecilia viewed 22-year-old Pamela Smart as the kind of person she aspired to be, good-looking, successful and confident.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚将22岁的帕梅拉·斯马特视为她渴望成为的那种人：漂亮、成功且自信。

sentences.en: When Cecilia mentioned an interest in journalism,
sentences.zh: 当塞西莉亚提到对新闻业感兴趣时，

sentences.en: Pamela suggested she work in the school's media centre as her intern.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉建议她到学校的媒体中心做实习生。

sentences.en: Cecilia gratefully accepted and began visiting Pamela's office for two periods a day, receiving credit for assisting with tasks such as writing the school board newsletter.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚感激地接受了，并开始每天两次去帕梅拉的办公室，通过协助撰写校董会通讯等任务获得学分。

sentences.en: She became increasingly comfortable in the role and came to value Pamela's attention and friendship.
sentences.zh: 她在岗位上越来越自在，并开始重视帕梅拉的关注和友谊。

sentences.en: Pamela had a tendency to make others feel wanted and heard, which Cecilia appreciated.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉有一种让别人感到被需要和被倾听的倾向，塞西莉亚对此很感激。

sentences.en: After a disagreement, she was surprised when Pamela apologised and hugged her, as Cecilia wasn't used to being treated with basic kindness.
sentences.zh: 发生争执后，当帕梅拉道歉并拥抱她时，她感到很惊讶，因为塞西莉亚不习惯受到基本的善待。

sentences.en: She began to confide in Pamela and viewed her as a role model and older sister figure.
sentences.zh: 她开始向帕梅拉吐露心声，并将她视为榜样和姐姐般的人物。

sentences.en: One day, Cecilia noticed a flyer on Pamela's desk advertising a high school video competition for students.
sentences.zh: 一天，塞西莉亚注意到帕梅拉的桌子上有一张传单，上面宣传着一项高中生视频比赛。

sentences.en: The task was to make a commercial promoting the nutritional value of orange juice, with prizes including a trip to Disney World.
sentences.zh: 任务是制作一个宣传橙汁营养价值的广告，奖品包括去迪士尼乐园旅行。

sentences.en: Cecilia asked some other students if they wanted to help submit a video.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚问其他一些学生是否想帮忙提交一段视频。

sentences.en: 15-year-old Billy Flynn wasn't very interested at first, but ultimately agreed to help out, mostly behind the camera.
sentences.zh: 15岁的比利·弗林起初不太感兴趣，但最终同意帮忙，主要是在幕后工作。

sentences.en: Billy came from the same rough area as Cecilia and also had a difficult home life.
sentences.zh: 比利和塞西莉亚来自同一个贫困地区，家庭生活也很困难。

sentences.en: His father was abusive and, as the oldest of three boys,
sentences.zh: 他的父亲有虐待倾向，作为三个男孩中的老大，

sentences.en: Billy was treated the harshest from an early age.
sentences.zh: 比利从小就受到了最严厉的对待。

sentences.en: When his parents eventually divorced, his mother moved him from California, which he found difficult to adjust to.
sentences.zh: 当他的父母最终离婚时，母亲把他从加利福尼亚搬走，他发现很难适应。

sentences.en: Not long after Billy enrolled at Winnicunard High School, his father died in a car crash.
sentences.zh: 比利进入温尼库尼特高中没多久，他的父亲就在一场车祸中去世了。

sentences.en: This had a strong emotional impact on him and he became more withdrawn.
sentences.zh: 这对他的情感影响很大，他变得更加孤僻。

sentences.en: Even though he seemed like a defiant rebel with his long hair, leather jacket, ear-piercing, love of metal music and rough group of friends,
sentences.zh: 尽管他留着长发、穿着皮夹克、戴着耳环、热爱金属音乐、有一群粗野的朋友，看起来像个叛逆的叛徒，

sentences.en: Billy was regarded as quiet and unassuming.
sentences.zh: 但比利被认为是一个安静且谦逊的人。

sentences.en: He kept to himself at school and didn't cause trouble.
sentences.zh: 他在学校里独来独往，不惹麻烦。

sentences.en: Recognising that Billy was another vulnerable teen in need of positive guidance,
sentences.zh: 意识到比利是另一个需要积极引导的脆弱少年，

sentences.en: Pamela also took him under her wing.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉也将他收归羽翼之下。

sentences.en: He helped her with tasks around the school and began regularly visiting her office to assist with administrative work.
sentences.zh: 他帮她处理学校里的杂务，并开始定期去她的办公室协助行政工作。

sentences.en: With the video competition underway,
sentences.zh: 随着视频比赛的进行，

sentences.en: Pamela helped the students brainstorm ideas and to choose a concept.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉帮助学生们集思广益，选择概念。

sentences.en: They met after school a few times each week and on Saturdays to work on the project.
sentences.zh: 他们每周放学后聚几次，周六也聚在一起做项目。

sentences.en: Whenever they started losing interest,
sentences.zh: 每当他们开始失去兴趣时，

sentences.en: Pamela encouraged them and helped them stay on track until they completed the video.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉就会鼓励他们，帮助他们保持进度，直到完成视频。

sentences.en: She drove them to filming locations and even agreed to appear in a scene as a cavewoman.
sentences.zh: 她开车送他们去拍摄地点，甚至同意在一个场景中扮演穴居人。

sentences.en: She raised eyebrows when she changed into her costume, a leopard print outfit described as skimpy.
sentences.zh: 当她换上那套被描述为暴露的豹纹服装时，引起了人们的侧目。

sentences.en: Billy recorded Pamela as she pretended to gather wood and wash clothes in a stream.
sentences.zh: 比利录下了帕梅拉假装在溪边捡柴和洗衣服的样子。

sentences.en: The finished video ran for approximately two and a half minutes.
sentences.zh: 完成的视频时长约为两分半钟。

sentences.en: It didn't win any prizes.
sentences.zh: 它没有赢得任何奖项。

sentences.en: By this point,
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，

sentences.en: Pamela had developed a close friendship with Billy Flynn, who had started visiting her office on a regular basis, often by himself.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉已经与比利·弗林建立了亲密的友谊，比利开始定期去她的办公室，通常是独自一人。

sentences.en: Pamela encouraged the visits and provided Billy with passes that excused him from class.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉鼓励这种拜访，并给比利提供了让他可以旷课的通行证。

sentences.en: On one occasion,
sentences.zh: 有一次，

sentences.en: Billy mentioned that a neighbour of his owned a photo development store and he could obtain discounted rates.
sentences.zh: 比利提到他的一位邻居拥有一家照片冲印店，他可以拿到折扣价。

sentences.en: Pamela gave him several rolls of undeveloped film and asked him to have them processed.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉给了他几卷未冲洗的胶卷，让他去冲洗。

sentences.en: The resulting photographs showed Pamela posing seductively on a bed in a bikini.
sentences.zh: 冲洗出来的照片显示帕梅拉穿着比基尼在床上摆出诱人的姿势。

sentences.en: When Billy returned to the photos,
sentences.zh: 当比利把照片拿回来时，

sentences.en: Pamela commented that she was unhappy with them.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉评论说她对这些照片不满意。

sentences.en: She said she intended to throw them away before suggesting that Billy keep them instead.
sentences.zh: 她说她打算把它们扔掉，然后建议比利留着它们。

sentences.en: After this,
sentences.zh: 此后，

sentences.en: Pamela asked Cecilia Pierce to come to her office.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉让塞西莉亚·皮尔斯到她的办公室来。

sentences.en: During a private conversation,
sentences.zh: 在一次私下谈话中，

sentences.en: Pamela told Cecilia that she believed she had developed romantic feelings for 15-year-old Billy Flynn.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉告诉塞西莉亚，她认为自己对15岁的比利·弗林产生了浪漫情愫。

sentences.en: Cecilia thought it was a joke, but Pamela insisted that she was serious.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚以为这是个玩笑，但帕梅拉坚持说她是认真的。

sentences.en: She asked Cecilia to bring Billy to her office so that she could speak with him.
sentences.zh: 她让塞西莉亚把比利带到她的办公室，以便她能和他谈谈。

sentences.en: When Billy arrived,
sentences.zh: 当比利到达时，

sentences.en: Pamela struggled to tell him what she wanted to say.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉难以启齿，不知道该说什么。

sentences.en: The following day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: Pamela still appeared nervous and reluctant to discuss the matter.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉看起来依然很紧张，不愿讨论这件事。

sentences.en: When Billy pressed her for an explanation, she finally revealed to him that she thought about him frequently and was struggling with her feelings because she was married.
sentences.zh: 当比利追问她原因时，她终于向他吐露，自己经常想起他，而且因为已婚的身份，她一直在情感中挣扎。

sentences.en: Stunned,
sentences.zh: 大为震惊，

sentences.en: Billy went back to class.
sentences.zh: 比利回到了课堂。

sentences.en: Things were awkward for a period afterwards, but Pamela continued to meet with Billy regularly.
sentences.zh: 在那之后的一段时间里，两人的关系有些尴尬，但帕梅拉仍继续定期与比利见面。

sentences.en: Their conversations became increasingly focused on Pamela's marriage, which she described as unhappy.
sentences.zh: 他们的谈话内容越来越集中在帕梅拉的婚姻上，她形容自己的婚姻并不幸福。

sentences.en: She stated that she had married Gregory largely because many of their friends were getting married at the time.
sentences.zh: 她说她嫁给格雷戈里主要是因为当时身边的许多朋友都结婚了。

sentences.en: She would call Gregory and deliberately provoke him into arguments, putting him on speakerphone so Billy could secretly listen to their heated exchanges.
sentences.zh: 她会打电话给格雷戈里，故意激怒他引发争吵，并打开免提，让比利偷偷听他们激烈的争执。

sentences.en: She also told Billy that Gregory was verbally and physically abusive, showing a bruise that she claimed he had caused.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉比利，格雷戈里在言语和身体上虐待她，并展示了一处她声称是他造成的淤青。

sentences.en: She described multiple instances in which Gregory was reportedly unkind to her.
sentences.zh: 她描述了多起格雷戈里据称对她不友善的事件。

sentences.en: Billy had no independent way of verifying these claiMs.
sentences.zh: 比利没有独立的渠道去核实这些说法。

sentences.en: However, because he trusted Pamela and had developed a close relationship with her, he largely accepted what she told him.
sentences.zh: 然而，因为他信任帕梅拉，并且与她建立了亲密的关系，他基本上相信了她所说的话。

sentences.en: He came to feel sorry for Pamela while growing to hate her husband.
sentences.zh: 他开始同情帕梅拉，同时也越来越憎恨她的丈夫。

sentences.en: It was around this time that Billy began reflecting on comments Pamela had made to him in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 大约就在这个时候，比利开始反思帕梅拉过去对他发表的评论。

sentences.en: She had once asked whether he knew anyone she could hire to kill her secretary so that a friend could take the woman's job.
sentences.zh: 她曾经问他是否认识可以雇佣来杀掉她秘书的人，这样她的一个朋友就能得到那份工作。

sentences.en: The question had seemed so blunt and implausible that Billy assumed it was a joke, but after Pamela confessed her feelings for him, she admitted that her earlier remarks
sentences.zh: 这个问题听起来太直白且不可思议，比利以为那只是个玩笑，但在帕梅拉向他表白后，她承认她之前的言论

sentences.en: hadn't been entirely made in jeSt.
sentences.zh: 并不完全是在开玩笑。

sentences.en: Pamela told Billy that she didn't actually want her secretary harmed.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉告诉比利，她其实并不想伤害她的秘书。

sentences.en: Instead, the person she wished were dead was her husband,
sentences.zh: 相反，她希望死去的人是她的丈夫，

sentences.en: Gregory.
sentences.zh: 格雷戈里。

sentences.en: Even after hearing this,
sentences.zh: 即使听到了这些，

sentences.en: Billy didn't believe
sentences.zh: 比利也不相信

sentences.en: Pamela was seriously proposing that anyone should be killed.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉是认真提议要杀掉某人。

sentences.en: He interpreted the comments as expressions of frustration and anger rather than genuine intentions.
sentences.zh: 他将这些言论解读为挫折感和愤怒的宣泄，而非真实的意图。

sentences.en: Pamela continued to raise the subject with Billy.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉继续向比利提起这个话题。

sentences.en: She said she wanted to be with him rather than Gregory, but divorce wasn't a viable option.
sentences.zh: 她说她想和他在一起，而不是格雷戈里，但离婚并非可行的选择。

sentences.en: She said Gregory wouldn't willingly let the marriage end and would make it difficult for her to move on with her life.
sentences.zh: 她说格雷戈里不会心甘情愿地结束这段婚姻，还会让她难以继续自己的生活。

sentences.en: She also expressed concerns about the financial consequences of a divorce.
sentences.zh: 她还表达了对离婚后经济后果的担忧。

sentences.en: Pamela claimed that Gregory would end up with most of their possessions, including their dog, while she would be left with very little.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉声称格雷戈里最终会拿走他们大部分的财产，包括他们的狗，而她将一无所有。

sentences.en: She said her salary wasn't enough to afford an apartment and that she didn't want to move back in with her parents.
sentences.zh: 她说她的薪水不足以负担公寓，而且她不想搬回父母家住。

sentences.en: She told Billy that she envisioned the two of them living together somewhere along the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 她告诉比利，她憧憬着两人能一起住在海岸边的某个地方。

sentences.en: To Billy,
sentences.zh: 对比利来说，

sentences.en: Pamela seemed like a decent person, even if her comments about Gregory confused him.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉看起来是个正派的人，尽管她关于格雷戈里的言论让他感到困惑。

sentences.en: He told her he didn't know anyone who could be hired to kill her husband and presumed that would be the end of the discussion.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他不认识可以雇来杀她丈夫的人，并以为讨论到此为止了。

sentences.en: Pamela then began making her relationship with Billy increasingly personal and spending more time with him outside of school.
sentences.zh: 随后，帕梅拉开始让两人的关系变得更加私密，并花更多时间在校外与他相处。

sentences.en: She even visited
sentences.zh: 她甚至在

sentences.en: Billy at his house when no one else was home.
sentences.zh: 家里没人的时候去比利家拜访过他。

sentences.en: In his room, she lay on his bed and asked if he was going to kiss her.
sentences.zh: 在他房间里，她躺在他的床上，问他要不要吻她。

sentences.en: When Billy didn't act,
sentences.zh: 当比利没有动作时，

sentences.en: Pamela asked, do I have to come over there and rape you?
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉问，我是不是得过去强奸你？

sentences.zh: 她随后对他实施了性侵犯。

sentences.en: Billy told several of his friends about what Pamela did, but they didn't believe him at firSt.
sentences.zh: 比利把帕梅拉对他做的事告诉了几个朋友，但他们起初并不相信他。

sentences.en: It wasn't until they witnessed her kissing him goodbye after dropping him off that they realised he was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 直到他们亲眼目睹她送他下车后吻别，才意识到他说的是真的。

sentences.en: Even then, they struggled to understand the situation.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，他们也很难理解这种情况。

sentences.en: They found it difficult to comprehend why a 22-year-old married woman would pursue a relationship with a 15-year-old high school boy.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得很难理解，为什么一个22岁的已婚妇女会去追求一个15岁的高中男生。

sentences.en: Billy wasn't the type of teenager who looked older, acted more mature, or seemed wiser than his years.
sentences.zh: 比利并不是那种看起来更成熟、举止更老练或比同龄人更聪明的少年。

sentences.en: Some suspected that Pamela must have had ulterior motives.
sentences.zh: 有些人怀疑帕梅拉一定有不可告人的动机。

sentences.en: On Valentine's Day in 1990, while Gregory was away on a ski trip,
sentences.zh: 1990年的情人节，当格雷戈里去滑雪旅行时，

sentences.en: Pamela invited
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉邀请了

sentences.en: Billy to spend the evening at her home.
sentences.zh: 比利去她家过夜。

sentences.en: She also invited
